hook: The textbook Greedy+Singleton knapsack heuristic has worst-case ratio exactly 0.42944
summary: The paper pins down the worst-case ratio of the standard heuristic for monotone submodular maximization under a knapsack constraint, closing a gap between 0.427 and 0.42945. The proof combines analytic bounds, interval-arithmetic checks and branch-and-bound, with hand-checkable bad instances. It also shows Wolsey's bound is tight for the stop-early variant. Parts of the proof rely on computer verification.
title: Greedy+Singleton for knapsack-constrained monotone submodular maximization has approximation ratio exactly $\beta^\star \approx 0.42944$
